"Fellow unakarūnians, as you may know the peace and political freedoms that have helped bring our country towards prosperity since the end of the Junta in 1996 are being threatened by extremists on both sides of the political spectrum. For this reason, in my charge as the temporary Prime Minister of unakarūn and with my best intentions to helped drive the nation to peace, I have decided to use the Armed Forces to oversee these elections, which will probably become the most tense in unakarūn's contemporary history. 

Though I recognize that the Army taking too much control could be seen as dangerous, mostly due to the bad memories caused by the Junta of Generals, it is important to recognize that unakarūn needs some sort of supervision in the elections, and the Army is the most prepared for the task. Most soldiers have joined the army or have been drafted during the democratic era, so it is very unlikely that they will attempt to, in any means, overthrow the democratic institutions. For these reasons I have made my decision that the army will help the law forces in making sure that the elections go without any incident."
 
The Melid drinks a glass of water. He is very tense.

"Now, adressing the extremist protests against my justified and calculated decision, I would like to say something"

He begins pulling out a paper, ready to read it.

"Here is a list of every incident that happened in the 2022 elections, in which only the police was called. As you can see, there were more than 70 incidents, of which 3 were fatal and other 14 caused injuries. Our goal as a nation with this measure is to prove that we are able to hold together. If the last elections, which had no major conflict, had seen so many incidents, we can only imagine how tomorrow's elections might be. I do understand the concerns about vote fraud, but do not worry. We will make sure that deployed soldiers are of various backgrounds and ideas, making fraud even more difficult.

This is all for my speech. unakarūn is going through harsh times, but we can endure. We have gone through worse, do not worry."

The Melid would then go inside his palace. He looked even more tense. At the end, it was his first time actually ruling.
